name: Customora for WooCommerce
author: Ravindu Aththanayake

sections.description:
A next-level WooCommerce sticker customizer. Customers design on a dedicated full page (not a popup) using a live Fabric.js canvas with separate front & back garment images per product, set by the admin.

Features

  • Dedicated Editor Page: Full-page design studio at /customize-garment/ — not a cramped modal.
  • Multi-View Support: Separate front, back, and optional side panel images per product.
  • Sticker Library: Admin sticker collection with category filtering and custom customer uploads.
  • Live Fabric.js Canvas: Smooth dragging, resizing, rotating, and placement.
  • Accurate Surcharges & Pricing: Dynamic pricing based on sticker sizes and quantities.
  • Variable Product Support: Select variation attributes (e.g., color, size) directly inside the design editor workspace.
  • Order & Cart Integration: Customized previews appear across Cart, Checkout, and Order management.
  • HPOS Compatible: Declared compatible with High-Performance Order Storage.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the customora-for-woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress (WooCommerce must be installed and active).
  3. Configure garment images and enable the customizer in the product edit screen meta-box.
  4. Manage default stickers in WooCommerce → Sticker Library.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce 8.0 or higher is required.

Can customers upload their own stickers?

Yes, customer sticker uploads (PNG, JPG, WebP) are supported with strict server-side validation and file sanitization.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
  • Full-page interactive fabric.js customizer.
  • In-editor variation selection for variable products.
  • Multi-panel views (Front, Back, Left, Right).
  • Sticker library management and secure customer upload validation.
  • Dynamic pricing calculations and order/cart integration.
